# ZBM UI

> ZBM UI is a modern, accessible, and customizable UI component library built with React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Base UI. This site is its documentation, covering installation, theming (including dark mode), forms integration, and a full component reference.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://ui.zubayer.dev/docs.md): What ZBM UI is, its key features, and how to get started.
- [Installation](https://ui.zubayer.dev/docs/installation.md): Set up ZBM UI in your project, including Tailwind CSS and required dependencies.
- [Dark Mode](https://ui.zubayer.dev/docs/dark-mode.md): Add dark mode with `next-themes` in Next.js or Vite apps.
- [Forms](https://ui.zubayer.dev/docs/forms.md): Build accessible forms, including integration with React Hook Form and Zod.
